title: feat(objectql): restore a recycle-bin entry under its original ids and emit data.record.restored (#30237 PR 3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi1a44tVerUCrhBK4MJbjCZx)_

Part of #30237
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #30847

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：回收站可以"恢复"了。`ObjectQL.restore(entryId)` 把一条回收站记录按原 id 写回（主记录先、明细随后），保留创建人和创建时间，不跑新建钩子；删除时被清空的引用在没人改过的前提下重新挂回；汇总字段重算；每行发一个 `data.record.restored` 事件；成功后这条回收站记录被删掉。spec 只动了您同意的范围：两个事件枚举加 `data.record.restored`，回收站常量注释和测试钉子翻转；按您 16:53Z 选的 C，新增第四个拒绝码 `RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN`（码表、错误码台账各一行），ADR-0148 D2 加一条、Consequences 加一句。
- 为什么改：ADR-0148 的第三步（#30237 拆分的 PR 3）。删除进回收站（PR 1）、彻底删除/清空（PR 2）已上线，没有恢复，回收站就只进不出。
- 风险与回滚：恢复要么整条成功要么什么都不写：唯一值被占、母记录已彻底删除、母记录还在回收站、对象已卸载这四种情况一律 409 拒绝，记录留在回收站；其中"母记录还在回收站"会给出母记录所在条目的 id，先恢复它就能再恢复子记录。权限读取要等 PR 4，在那之前非系统调用者一律被安全插件拒绝，所以这个 PR 上线后普通用户还用不到恢复，只有系统上下文能用。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/restore.ts`（`judgeRestore` 四个拒绝、`writeBack` 的事务与逐笔撤销）；`docs/adr/0148-…md` 的 D2 与 Consequences；`packages/spec/src/data/recycle-bin.zod.ts` 码表；`packages/spec/src/api/events.zod.ts` 与 `realtime.zod.ts`（枚举加值）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/recycle-bin/restore.test.ts`，应看到 26 个用例全过，含四个 409 和"不跑新建钩子"。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改了 `docs/adr/`，属 Tier H：席位用 Fable 复核 spec、ADR 和实现拒绝的代码，ACCEPT 后请您亲手合并或入队。

## What changes

**`ObjectQL.restore(entryId, { context })`** (new, `packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/restore.ts`; the engine keeps a delegation stub, so the facade gate holds with no new registry row):

- Reads the entry raw through the bin's driver, scoped to the caller's organization, and answers `null` when no entry is visible or no bin is registered. A malformed entry id is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (`param: 'entryId'`), as `purge(entryId)` refuses one.
- Dispatches ONE `restore` operation on the business object of the entry's master row, with no `ast` and no id, as `purge(entryId)` is dispatched.
- **Judges before it writes** (reads only, as the caller). Each refusal is `409` in the ADR-0112 envelope with `object`, `recordId`, `field`, `entryId` where they apply, and writes nothing; the entry stays:
  - `RESTORE_PACKAGE_UNINSTALLED`: an object of the entry is no longer registered;
  - `RESTORE_PARENT_PURGED`: a row's master-detail parent is neither live, nor a row of this entry, nor held by another entry, or its object is no longer registered (`parentObject`, `parentId`);
  - `RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN`: a row's master-detail parent is not live but is held by another entry, as that entry's master or as a row of its cascade (`parentObject`, `parentId`, `parentEntryId`). The parents that are neither live nor in the entry are collected across every row and field first (each probed once), then answered together: one indexed master lookup per parent object, and for the rest (the cascade-row case, `account ← contact ← task`: the task deleted alone, then the account) at most ONE walk over the entries the caller can see by key (`keysetWalk`, pages of 200), each snapshot searched, stopping once every parent is answered. All on the refusal path only; a walk the store cut short throws a store-defect error, not a refusal. Unlike the other three it is not permanent: restoring the parent's entry first lets this one through, which two tests drive end to end. It is answered only after every row has been judged for the three permanent refusals, so it never hides one;
  - `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN`: a live row holds the id or a unique value (`unique: true | 'organization'` scoped to the row's own organization, `'global'` unscoped) of a snapshotted row. A value the caller cannot see (a global unique across organizations) is caught by the store's own unique constraint at the write, and answered with the same code.
- **Writes back in one unit of work**: the rows raw through each object's driver, the master first, under their original ids, `created_by` / `created_at` as the snapshot holds them, no insert hook; then the re-links; then the entry's removal (last, so a restore that did not land keeps its entry). One transaction when every object involved is stored by the bin's driver; otherwise each write already made is undone when a later one fails, and the split is logged at `warn`.
- **Re-link (ADR-0148 D2, both arities per the #30577 review should-fix 1)** through `engine.update` with the restore's context, as the delete's `set_null` clear went: a single-valued field while it still holds no value; a multi-valued one while it no longer holds the member (the member is appended).
- **Roll-ups** recompute from the rows that are back, one `recomputeSummaries` call per object; a failure surfaces as `SummaryRecomputeError` after the rows are back, as on insert.
- **Events**: one `data.record.restored` per row, master first, through the engine's own `publishDataEvent` (credential mask, `internal` omission and `organizationId` off the row, as every record event).

**Engine shape** (hand-over 6690307585, "How PR 2 shaped the engine"):

- `OperationContext['operation']` gains `'restore'`; `ENGINE_OPERATION_VERBS.restore = false`, so `beforeRestore` / `afterRestore` stay outside the hook namespace and `registerHook` is not narrowed.
- `restore` joins `WRITE_EPOCH_OPERATIONS`.
- The #7809 pin (`engine-middleware-operation-vocabulary.test.ts`) holds 9 verbs; `restore` is a dispatched destructive verb, never with an AST, object-level only.
- plugin-security is untouched: `DESTRUCTIVE_OPERATIONS` already refuses `restore` fail-closed for every non-system caller. A new pin in `security-plugin.test.ts` holds that for the engine's object-level dispatch, for a caller holding every CRUD bit, both super-user bypasses and both new grant keys, with no row read.

**Spec (consent records 6709046255, 「A 同意三处（推荐）」, and 6710220841, ruling C 「C 新码,并入 PR 3(推荐)」)**, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`:

- `packages/spec/src/api/events.zod.ts`: `DataEventType` gains `'data.record.restored'`; its docblock says four events and names `RECORD_RESTORED_EVENT`.
- `packages/spec/src/api/realtime.zod.ts`: `RealtimeEventType` gains the same value; its docblock lists it.
- `packages/spec/src/data/recycle-bin.zod.ts`: the "NAMED, NOT YET EMITTED" comment flips to emitted; `recycle-bin.zod.test.ts`'s pin flips to "a member of both enums".
- `packages/spec/src/api/events.test.ts`: the `DataEventType.options` equality pin gains the value (seat ruling Q2, recorded on #30237, the mechanical consequence of the consented enum change).
- `packages/spec/src/data/recycle-bin.zod.ts`: `RECYCLE_BIN_RESTORE_REFUSAL_CODES` gains `parentInRecycleBin: 'RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN'`; the doc comment says four codes, the first three permanent for the entry, the fourth clearing once the parent's entry is restored. `recycle-bin.zod.test.ts` pins four codes.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`: the code joins the `@objectstack/objectql` block (the block's comment says four); `error-code-ledger.test.ts` pins the four values in order.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/events.mdx`, `realtime.mdx`, `error-code-ledger.mdx`, `automation-api.mdx`, `contract.mdx` (`gen:docs`). No export added or removed in spec.

**ADR (Tier H, ruling 6710220841):** `docs/adr/0148-…md` D2 gains a fourth refusal bullet (the parent is in the bin; dated, citing the ruling record), and Consequences gains one sentence: the fourth refusal is not permanent. The status line, D5's reader table and the rest are untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- **Parent in the bin (ruling C, 6710220841; replaces the seat's interim Q1 = A):** answered by its own code `RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN`, not `RESTORE_PARENT_PURGED`. The interim answer is gone with no fallback; an ablation that stamps the interim code back turns the refusal's tests red.
- Known gap: ADR-0148 D5's reader table still lists the refusal codes in words as "unique value taken, parent purged, package uninstalled". That row is outside the ADR hunk ruling 6710220841 consented to, so this PR leaves it (seat, contract review round 1).
- Contract review round 1 (6711252037), fixed in `511372165`: a parent held as a cascade row of another entry was answered `RESTORE_PARENT_PURGED` (must-fix); a parent in the bin could hide a permanent refusal of a later row (should-fix); a parent whose object is unregistered now answers `RESTORE_PARENT_PURGED`. The refusal codes and 409 stay literal stamps in `restore.ts`, the form `check:error-status-conformance` reads (its assignment reader pairs `err.code = '...'` with the status); a test pins the four codes and 409 by value against `RECYCLE_BIN_RESTORE_REFUSAL_CODES` / `_STATUS`.
- Contract review round 2 (6711739005), fixed in `82b042200`: the miss path walked the bin once per (row, field); it now walks it at most once per restore, pinned by a test that counts bin reads (3 for five lines under one parent). An unregistered parent object's refusal now says the object no longer exists, rather than "deleted for good".
- A failed restore outside a transaction that had already re-linked a reference publishes two `data.record.updated` events for that row (the re-link and its undo), since both go through `engine.update`; a comment in `writeBack` says so.
- The re-link runs as the restoring caller, as the clear ran as the deleting one. Until PR 4 only the system restores, so nothing can be refused there today; PR 4 decides whether a restorer who may not edit the referencing row re-links it.
- A composite unique index (`indexes[].unique`) is not probed before the write; the store's constraint catches it at the write and it is answered `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN`, the unit undone.
- A plain (non master-detail) lookup in a restored row that points at a row deleted since stays as the snapshot holds it; ADR-0148 names no refusal for it.
- Not in this PR: the permission reader (PR 4), the REST doors (PR 5), the Console (#30239), the skills text (#30847). `@objectstack/client`'s `subscribeToRecords` still lists created/updated/deleted only (an explicit list, not an exhaustive switch); whether it also subscribes to `restored` by default is PR 5's / #30239's choice. `service-knowledge` does not re-index a restored record; it listens to created/updated only.
- Dispatch-order conflict, resolved by the rules file: the order asked for `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, but the claim declares `Metadata-protocol: none`, and AGENTS.md step 3 / `check-changeset-no-major` grade a `none` change `patch`. The changeset is `patch` for both packages.

## Tests

All on head `82b042200` (the merge of `origin/main` 13c6d8ff8, the ruling-C commit, and the contract-review round 1 and 2 fixes):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/recycle-bin/restore.test.ts`: Tests 31 passed (31). Round trip and dispatch shape, `created_by` / `created_at` kept, no insert hook, restored events, roll-up recompute, organization scoping, null and bad-id answers, the security refusal and the system path, re-link for both arities (changed since, row gone, the `relinkedValue` units), and the refusals: `RESTORE_PACKAGE_UNINSTALLED`; `RESTORE_PARENT_PURGED` (parent purged; parent object unregistered); `RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN` (parent the master of another entry; grandchild whose parent is a cascade row of another entry, each refused, then the parent's entry restored, then the row restores); five lines under one parent held as a cascade row answered with 3 bin reads; a permanent refusal (id taken) winning over a parent in the bin; `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN` (a value, a per-organization value in another organization allowed, the id, and the store's own violation with the undo); the four codes and 409 pinned by value against the spec constants.
- Full `@objectstack/objectql` suite on `82b042200`: Test Files 566 passed (566), Tests 11458 passed (11458).
- On `ff9ad72fb` (the review fixes touch only `restore.ts` and its test): full `@objectstack/plugin-security` Test Files 248 passed, Tests 5821 passed, 45 skipped, with the new pin `[#30237] DENIES the engine's object-level restore dispatch fail-closed`; full `@objectstack/spec` Test Files 911 passed, Tests 27487 passed, 1 todo.

| first reason wins (in-bin thrown at the reference, not deferred) | 1 failed, 30 passed: `a permanent refusal wins over RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN` |

| `'restore'` removed from plugin-security `DESTRUCTIVE_OPERATIONS` (`vitest run src/security-plugin.test.ts -t 30237`, on `ff9ad72fb`) | 1 failed: `promise resolved ... instead of rejecting`; clean run 1 passed |
